harnesses.name: atlassian
harnesses.description: Discover Atlassian MCP operations using interactive OAuth.
prerequisites: An Atlassian account with access to the target site
Node.js and npx for the mcp-remote OAuth bridge

harnesses.name: playwright
harnesses.description: Discover and run the real Playwright MCP browser server.
prerequisites: Playwright browser binaries and operating system dependencies

harnesses.name: github
harnesses.description: Discover GitHub MCP operations using GITHUB_TOKEN.
prerequisites: GITHUB_TOKEN with access to the intended repositories

harnesses.name: github-rest
harnesses.description: Read a repository through the public GitHub REST API.
prerequisites: Network access to api.github.com; public API rate limits apply

harnesses.name: inkscape
harnesses.description: Inspect Inkscape and export local SVG files to new PNG files.
prerequisites: Inkscape executable available as inkscape or through INKSCAPE_BIN
